Asset-1 is the actual first-frame anchor, so the entire multi-panel reference sheet, including all labeled sections and the studio backdrop, must remain intact at the anchored instant rather than being cropped into a hero panel. The single continuous shot keeps the full sheet visible while adding restrained life inside it: drifting rain, shimmering reflections, and a subtle breath in the HERO panel, supported by a slow small push-in that provides the requested drifting camera motion. No spoken lines, singing, or visible text are requested; the existing labels are preserved as part of the anchored frame, not newly authored on-screen text. Balanced creativity permits music, but no score or sound is added as requested content, and all prohibitions remain false.
